name: Klefki

abilities.name: Dismantling Keys
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent’s Active Pokémon. If you do, discard this Pokémon.

flavor:
In the past, noble families entrusted their vault
keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down
through the generations, taking good care of it.
